changes: Explicit FlightGear external defaults and model-specific control defaults.
Development internal fuel 2500 lb/tank, total 5000 lb; source empty mass/CG/inertias/aero unchanged.
Provisional inspected fan/nozzle force points.
Fixed-step experimental STOVL FCS allocation, attitude damping, vector nozzle orientation and2.5s actuator.
Fan-door aerodynamic mixture position and conversion augmentation cap.
Experimental dynamic-pressure yaw gain schedule suppresses disturbance-driven rudder hunting at high speed; pilot command properties unchanged.
Native Auto/Manual/FBW selection; Manual bypasses stabilization, resets integrators and uses direct stick/trim/flap commands while preserving conversion.

Conversion augmentation interlock covers every positive request or pre-step physical position, preserves inhibition through zero-time recovery, and clears on conventional positive-time evaluation; new-flight profile clears the latch.
Trailing-edge automatic flaps default enabled, independent of manual/FBW control-law selection.
Lift allocation uses current main upward native body force and current CG arms; auxiliaries are immediate zero-fuel force carriers, removing duplicate conversion gating and independent turbine lag.
Two 6550 lb internal tanks total the published 13100 lb internal capacity; retained external capacity is 2991 lb per detachable store.

External stores initially attach empty; native attachment gates fuel, feed priority, provisional 300 lb tank/pylon dry mass and 1 square foot equivalent drag area per store, applied natively in the wind frame at each store location for asymmetric force/moment response. Fuel and dry mass align to visible assemblies at structural x368.52, y+/-127.952756, z-15.36 inches.

FBW roll is a tracked roll-rate command: full stick asks for native fcs/full-stick-roll-rate-deg_sec (default 636.62, the source gradient), with feedforward p = a vt / 165 ft faded out by conversion. The source integrator trigger was inverted (held above 5 kt); the integrator now only holds bank, running with the stick centred and roll rate under 10 deg/s and resetting in Manual, on the ground and with any conversion. P and D gains unchanged; Manual and hover roll posts read the unscaled stick.

FBW roll trim enters the rate command and feedforward as native fcs/roll-trim-rate-cmd-norm, scaled like the stick by fcs/full-stick-roll-rate-deg_sec, so full trim asks what full stick asks; it entered unscaled. Manual and hover roll posts take trim as they take the stick.
Native automatic augmentation in conventional flight.
Progressive dry-thrust reduction to18klbf full-conversion reference before source bleed.
Conversion-dependent approximate main fuel accounting for auxiliary power.
Zero separate TSFC/idle fuel flow/bleed for force surrogate.
Actual main upward native force supplies fan power; current main/fan CG arms and existing pitch allocation determine desired force, capped by retained source atmospheric capacity.
Zero independent idle force; immediate carrier setting removes fictitious auxiliary spool lag.
Zero separate TSFC/idle fuel flow/bleed for force surrogate.
Actual main upward native force and retained 1950/18000 rating ratio supply each roll post; existing differential allocation is capped by retained source atmospheric capacity.
Zero independent idle force; immediate carrier setting removes fictitious auxiliary spool lag.
